name: gmail
description: Highly popular email service by Google. Gmail tracks all of your email conversations.

setup.title: Create a Google Cloud OAuth app

steps.text: Enable the Gmail API for your Google Cloud project.
On the OAuth consent screen, set User type to Internal.
steps.why: Internal avoids the Google app verification and annual CASA security assessment that Gmail's restricted scopes otherwise require, and stops refresh tokens expiring every 7 days.

steps.text: In Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type Web application, then add this redirect URI to its Authorised redirect URIs:
steps.why: Google rejects the authorization if the redirect URI does not match character for character, including the scheme and any trailing slash.

notes.authorize: Sign in as the SHARED MAILBOX ACCOUNT, not as yourself. Whichever account approves this is the mailbox everyone will read — read-only, so nothing can be sent, labelled or deleted.
notes.verify: This reports which mailbox you are actually connected to — worth reading before you rely on it.

telemetry.description: Searched messages and read their contents
